newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy car dealers for $70 mln.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy car dealers for $70 mln.

text.p: Intensifying its drive to build a car megadealer chain, Republic Industries Inc said Tuesday it was entering the Las Vegas and Atlanta markets with agreements to buy a dealership in each of those cities for a total of $70 million in stock.
Republic said it had signed definitive agreements to acquire the Desert Buick-GMC Automotive Group of Las Vegas, and Gene Evans Ford of Union City, Ga., in separate transactions.
The transactions include all related real estate and are subject to certain conditions, including manufacturer and government approval, Republic said.
Larry Carter, 56, chief executive officer of Desert Buick-GMC, will sign a long-term employment agreement with Republic and will retain his responsibilities at the dealership, Republic said.
Gene Evans, the owner of the Atlanta dealership, will sign a similar employment agreement and continue with his responsibilities, it said.
